title.zh: 卷157 志一百三十二 邦交五 德意志
title.raw: 卷157 志一百三十二 邦交五 德意志

sentences.zh: 德意志者，日爾曼列國總部名也，舊名邪馬尼，居歐洲中原，同盟三十六國，而中惟布路斯最強。

translations.literal: "Deutschland" is the collective name of the Germanic states; its old name was Xiemani. It lies in central Europe, in alliance with thirty-six states, among which Prussia alone was strongest.
translations.idiomatic: Germany was the collective designation of the German states—formerly called Xiemani—occupying central Europe in a confederation of thirty-six polities, of which Prussia was by far the strongest.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月，布國遣使臣李福斯來京，欲見總署王大臣呈遞國書。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, third month, Prussia sent the minister Li Fusi to the capital, wishing to see the prince-ministers of the Foreign Office and present a letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, the third month, Prussia dispatched Envoy Count Eulenburg to Beijing to present credentials to the Yamen's senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 三口通商大臣崇厚以聞，並稱布國坐來兵船，在大沽攔江沙外扣留丹國商船三艘。

translations.literal: Chonghou, minister for trade at the Three Ports, reported this, and also stated that Prussian warships that had come were outside the Jiangsha bar at Dagu, where they detained three Danish merchant vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Trade Superintendent Chonghou at the Three Ports reported the visit and added that Prussian warships had detained three Danish merchant ships outside the Jiangsha shoal at Dagu.

sentences.zh: 總署以布使不應在中國洋面扣留敵船，詰之。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office held that the Prussian envoy ought not to detain enemy ships on Chinese waters, and questioned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen protested that the Prussian minister had no right to seize enemy vessels in Chinese waters and demanded an explanation.

sentences.zh: 李福斯接牒，即將丹船放回二艘，並遣譯官謝罪，總署始允會晤。

translations.literal: Li Fusi received the note, at once released two of the Danish ships, and sent an interpreter to apologize; only then did the Foreign Office permit a meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Eulenburg, on receiving the dispatch, released two Danish ships and sent an interpreter to apologize, after which the Yamen agreed to receive him.

sentences.zh: 七年夏四月，布路斯君主維利恩復以李福斯為秉權大臣，來華呈遞國書。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, summer, fourth month, the Prussian sovereign Wilhelm again appointed Li Fusi plenipotentiary minister and sent him to China to present a letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the seventh year, the fourth month, King Wilhelm of Prussia again sent Eulenburg as plenipotentiary minister to present credentials in China.

sentences.zh: 八年，咸伯國商人美利士私在臺灣大南澳境伐木墾荒，閩浙總督以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, a Hamburg merchant named Mellish privately felled timber and opened land in the Tainan-ao region of Taiwan; the governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year a Hamburg merchant, Mellish, was reported to have been logging and clearing land without permission in the Tainan-ao district of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 總署以美利士違約妄為，牒布使詰問，請其查辦。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office, holding that Mellish had acted in violation of treaty and on his own authority, sent a note to the Prussian minister to question him and ask that the matter be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen noted that Mellish had breached treaty and acted on his own, and asked the Prussian minister to investigate.

sentences.zh: 十年春，李福斯遞國書，言德意志各國共推戴布國君主為德意志國大皇帝，中國覆書致賀。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, Li Fusi presented a letter of credence stating that the German states had jointly raised the Prussian sovereign to be Great Emperor of the German Empire; China replied with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year Eulenburg presented credentials announcing the German states' proclamation of the Prussian king as German Emperor; China sent a congratulatory reply.

sentences.zh: 是年李福斯回國，以領事安訥克為署使。

translations.literal: That year Li Fusi returned home, and the consul Anacker was left as chargé d'affaires.
translations.idiomatic: That year Eulenburg returned home and Consul Anacker was left in charge.

sentences.zh: 十一年，安訥克以條約十年期滿，牒中國請換約，未果。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Anacker, on the ground that the ten-year term of the treaty had expired, sent a note to China requesting renewal; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Anacker asked China to renew the treaty on the ground that its ten-year term had expired, but no agreement was reached.

sentences.zh: 李福斯復來，十二月，復遞國書。

translations.literal: Li Fusi came again; in the twelfth month he again presented a letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: Eulenburg returned and in the twelfth month again presented credentials.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，穆宗親政，請覲見，許之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year the Emperor Muzong personally took power; he requested an audience and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, after the Tongzhi Emperor began to rule in person, Eulenburg requested an audience and was granted one.

sentences.zh: 屆時李福斯因病回國，署使和立本特備文慶賀，因聲明將來本國使臣朝覲，應按此次所定節略辦理，許之。

translations.literal: When the time came Li Fusi returned home on account of illness; the chargé Holborn specially prepared a document of congratulation and declared that future ministers of his country coming to audience should be handled according to the protocol settled on this occasion; this was allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Eulenburg had by then returned home ill; Chargé Holborn presented congratulations and stated that future German ministers' audiences should follow the protocol just agreed; China assented.

sentences.zh: 九月，德國安訥船在福建洋面遭水賊殺斃船主、大夥，並毀其船，閩撫丁日昌當將犯拏獲斬梟，並追贓一萬三千餘元。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the German ship Anna on the Fujian coast was attacked by pirates, who killed the master and crew and destroyed the vessel; Fujian governor Ding Richang at once seized the culprits, executed and exposed them, and recovered more than thirteen thousand yuan of stolen goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month pirates on the Fujian coast killed the master and crew of the German ship Anna and destroyed the vessel; Governor Ding Richang captured and executed the culprits and recovered over thirteen thousand yuan in stolen property.

sentences.zh: 德使責中國賠償，總署以德約三十三款明言不能賠償贓物，不許。

translations.literal: The German minister demanded compensation from China; the Foreign Office, citing Article 33 of the German treaty, which clearly states that stolen goods cannot be compensated, refused.
translations.idiomatic: The German minister demanded compensation, but the Yamen refused, citing Article 33 of the German treaty, which expressly excludes compensation for stolen goods.

sentences.zh: 二年，德以巴蘭德為駐華公使。

translations.literal: In the second year Germany appointed Brandt minister to China.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Germany appointed von Brandt minister to China.

sentences.zh: 春三月，直隸總督李鴻章始遣遊擊卞長勝等五弁，赴德武學院學習陸軍槍砲操法。

translations.literal: In spring, third month, Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Zhili, first sent the battalion commander Bian Changsheng and four other officers to the German military academy to learn infantry drill with firearms and artillery.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third month Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Zhili, first sent Battalion Commander Bian Changsheng and four other officers to Germany's military academy to train in infantry firearms and artillery drill.

sentences.zh: 巴蘭德牒總督，催請換約。

translations.literal: Brandt sent a note to the governor-general urging renewal of the treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Von Brandt wrote the governor-general pressing for treaty renewal.

sentences.zh: 十月，巴蘭德復牒總署索三事：一，洋商在租界內售賣洋貨，不再抽釐金；

translations.literal: In the tenth month Brandt again sent a note to the Foreign Office demanding three things: first, that foreign merchants selling foreign goods within the concessions should no longer pay likin;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month von Brandt again wrote the Yamen demanding three concessions: first, that foreign goods sold by foreign merchants within the concessions be exempt from likin;

sentences.zh: 二，發給存票，不立期限，並准其以存票支取現銀；

translations.literal: second, that deposit receipts be issued without fixed term and that they be allowed to draw cash silver against them;
translations.idiomatic: second, that deposit receipts be issued without time limit and be redeemable for silver on demand;

sentences.zh: 三，德商入內地採買土貨，准攜現銀。

translations.literal: third, that German merchants going inland to purchase native goods be permitted to carry cash silver.
translations.idiomatic: third, that German merchants buying native goods inland be allowed to carry silver cash.

sentences.zh: 又請於年內開辦上海一口；

translations.literal: He also asked that Shanghai be opened as a port within the year;
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Shanghai be opened as a port before year's end;

sentences.zh: 又求在大孤山添開口岸，鄱陽湖拖帶輪船，吳淞口上下貨物三端。

translations.literal: and further sought to add Dagushan as a treaty port, to allow steam towing on Poyang Lake, and to load and unload cargo at the mouth of Wusong—three points in all.
translations.idiomatic: and further sought three additional points: opening Dagushan as a treaty port, allowing steam towing on Poyang Lake, and permitting cargo handling at Wusong.

sentences.zh: 總署拒之，屢辯駮，不省。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office refused; they argued back and forth repeatedly, but he would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen refused; after repeated exchanges he would not relent.

sentences.zh: 明年五月，遂偕繙譯官阿恩德出京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the following year he left the capital together with the interpreter Arnhold.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the following year he left Beijing with interpreter Arnhold.

sentences.zh: 既抵天津，往晤李鴻章，鴻章曉以兩國意見即有不合，應往返商辦，力勸之，巴使乃回京。

translations.literal: Having reached Tianjin, he called on Li Hongzhang; Hongzhang explained that even when the two countries' views did not agree they should negotiate back and forth, and urged him strongly; the German minister then returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Tianjin he called on Li Hongzhang, who urged that differences be settled through continued negotiation and persuaded him to return to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 總署促與開議，忽言俟十月間再議。

translations.literal: The Foreign Office pressed him to open negotiations, but he suddenly said they should wait until the tenth month to discuss again.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yamen pressed him to open talks, he suddenly said discussion should wait until the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 是年德使館定居東交民巷，仍納租價。

translations.literal: That year the German legation was permanently established in Dongjiaomin Lane, still paying rent.
translations.idiomatic: That year the German legation was permanently established in the Legation Quarter, rent still being paid.

sentences.zh: 四年，以光祿寺少卿劉錫鴻為出使德國大臣，並遞國書。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Liu Xihong, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed minister to Germany and presented a letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Liu Xihong was appointed minister to Germany and presented credentials.

sentences.zh: 劉錫鴻尋奏，聞德外務大臣促巴蘭德速立新約，而巴蘭德於吳淞起卸貨物、鄱陽拖帶輪船、內地租住店房三條仍力爭，至是竟回國。

translations.literal: Liu Xihong soon memorialized that he had heard the German foreign minister was urging Brandt to conclude a new treaty quickly, while Brandt still pressed hard on the three points of loading and unloading at Wusong, steam towing on Poyang Lake, and renting shops inland; at this he actually returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xihong soon reported that Berlin was pressing von Brandt to conclude a new treaty quickly, while von Brandt still fought hard for Wusong cargo handling, Poyang steam towing, and inland shop leases—and then left China.

sentences.zh: 明年閏三月，巴使復來華議約，仍著重前三條。

translations.literal: In the intercalary third month of the following year the German minister came again to China to negotiate the treaty, still emphasizing the first three articles.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month of the following year von Brandt returned to negotiate, still stressing the same three demands.

sentences.zh: 時德丕里約夾板船至山東榮成縣所屬海面觸礁，巴使要求賠償，拒之。

translations.literal: At that time the German bark Peri ran aground on the sea off Rongcheng county in Shandong; the German minister demanded compensation and was refused.
translations.idiomatic: When the German bark Peri ran aground off Rongcheng in Shandong, von Brandt demanded compensation and was refused.

sentences.zh: 巴使又以天津紫竹林無德國租界，要求在法界以上另添租界，不許。

translations.literal: The German minister also, because there was no German concession at Zizhulin in Tianjin, asked for an additional concession above the French quarter; this was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for a German concession above the French quarter at Tianjin's Zizhulin, where none existed; this too was refused.

sentences.zh: 是年閏五月，以候選道李鳳苞為出使德國大臣。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of that year Li Fengbao, a candidate for the rank of circuit intendant, was appointed minister to Germany.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month of that year Li Fengbao was appointed minister to Germany.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月，朝廷因德約議久未成，特派總理各國事務、協辦大學士、兵部尚書沈桂芬，戶部尚書景廉為全權大臣，復與巴使開議。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, second month, because negotiations on the German treaty had long remained unsettled, the court specially appointed Shen Guifen, superintendent of foreign affairs and associate grand secretary and minister of War, and Jing Lian, minister of Revenue, as plenipotentiaries to reopen talks with the German minister.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, the second month, with German treaty talks long stalled, the court appointed Shen Guifen and Jing Lian as plenipotentiaries to reopen negotiations with von Brandt.

sentences.zh: 久之，巴使始允將「大孤山、鄱陽湖及洋商入內地」刪去，並照英國新約辦法，彼此條款略相抵；

translations.literal: After a long time the German minister finally agreed to delete "Dagushan, Poyang Lake, and foreign merchants entering the interior," and to follow the method of Britain's new treaty, with the two sides' articles roughly balancing one another;
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged negotiation von Brandt finally agreed to drop Dagushan, Poyang Lake, and inland trade, and to follow the pattern of Britain's new treaty with roughly reciprocal terms;

sentences.zh: 惟江蘇吳淞口一處，允德船隻暫停泊，上下客商貨物，章程仍由中國江海關道自訂。

translations.literal: only at the mouth of Wusong in Jiangsu was German shipping temporarily allowed to anchor and load and unload passengers' and merchants' goods, the regulations still to be drawn up by China's maritime customs circuit.
translations.idiomatic: only at Wusong in Jiangsu were German vessels temporarily allowed to anchor and handle cargo, regulations to be set by China's maritime customs.

sentences.zh: 遂於二月二十一日畫押，並聲明二事：一，德國夾板在中國口岸停泊十四日以外者，則自第十五日起，即于應交正數船鈔減半，先行試辦；

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the second month they initialed the treaty and declared two matters: first, that German sailing vessels mooring at Chinese ports beyond fourteen days should, from the fifteenth day onward, pay half the regular tonnage dues as a trial measure;
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first of the second month they initialed the treaty with two declarations: first, German sailing vessels staying beyond fourteen days at Chinese ports would pay half tonnage dues from the fifteenth day onward, on trial;

sentences.zh: 一，第六款內「德國允，德國人等」條內有「遊歷」二字，德譯與華文不符，應將德文字意更正。

translations.literal: second, in Article 6, in the clause "Germany permits German subjects," the two characters for "travel" in the Chinese text did not match the German translation and the German wording should be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: second, the word "travel" in Article 6's Chinese text did not match the German version and the German wording should be corrected.

sentences.zh: 遂約自畫押之日起，限一年內互換。

translations.literal: It was agreed that exchange should take place within one year from the date of initialing.
translations.idiomatic: Exchange was to take place within one year of initialing.

sentences.zh: 已，巴使於六月三十日又來牒，稱德國國法，凡議立條約，必須先問國會，國會允許，方能批准；

translations.literal: Thereafter, on the thirtieth day of the sixth month the German minister again sent a note, stating that under German law every treaty must first be submitted to parliament, and only after parliament consents can it be ratified;
translations.idiomatic: Later, on the thirtieth of the sixth month von Brandt wrote that under German law treaties must be submitted to parliament and ratified only after approval;

sentences.zh: 本國國會約在明年，所議三月初二日互換約章一款，請將期限改為光緒七年十月初十日。

translations.literal: his country's parliament would meet about the next year; the article fixing exchange on the second day of the third month should be changed to the tenth day of the tenth month of the seventh year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: parliament would not meet until the following year, and he asked to change the exchange date from the second of the third month to the tenth of the tenth month, Guangxu 7.

sentences.zh: 七年秋七月，巴使請定期互換條約，政府命景廉與巴使在北京總署畫押互換，是為中德續約十款，並善後章程九條。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, autumn, seventh month, the German minister asked to fix a date for exchange; the government ordered Jing Lian and the German minister to initial and exchange at the Beijing Foreign Office; this was the Sino-German supplementary treaty of ten articles, with nine articles of supplementary regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Guangxu 7, von Brandt asked to set an exchange date; Jing Lian and von Brandt exchanged the Sino-German supplementary treaty of ten articles and nine supplementary regulations at the Yamen in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 八年夏六月，德始與朝鮮議約，中國派員蒞盟，聲明為中國屬邦。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, summer, sixth month, Germany first negotiated a treaty with Korea; China sent an officer to attend the signing and declared that Korea was China's dependency.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, Guangxu 8, Germany first negotiated a treaty with Korea; China sent a representative to the signing and declared Korea a dependency.

sentences.zh: 九年冬十月，議結德魯麟洋行地畝案。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, winter, tenth month, the case of the Drewsen & Co. firm's land was settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Guangxu 9, the Drewsen & Co. land dispute was settled.

sentences.zh: 初，廣東汕頭新開附地有海坪官地，中國欲填築作為商埠，忽有德魯麟洋行買辦華民郭繼宗謂系伊地，陰結德駐汕頭領事沙博哈，及德水師兵船，豎旗強佔。

translations.literal: Initially, on the newly opened foreshore at Shantou in Guangdong there was official tidal land that China wished to reclaim as a commercial port; suddenly Guo Jizong, a Chinese comprador for Drewsen & Co., claimed it was his land, secretly joined with the German consul at Shantou, Schab, and German naval vessels, raised flags, and seized it by force.
translations.idiomatic: At Shantou's newly opened foreshore, China planned to reclaim official tidal land for a commercial port when Guo Jizong, comprador for Drewsen & Co., claimed it as his own, colluded with German Consul Schab and warships, and seized it by force under the German flag.

sentences.zh: 中國聞之，牒向德使詰問，並命出使大臣李鳳苞與德外部辯論。

translations.literal: When China learned of it, a note was sent to the German minister to question him, and Minister Li Fengbao was ordered to debate with the German foreign office.
translations.idiomatic: China protested to the German minister and ordered Minister Li Fengbao to press the case in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 時德相為畢士馬克，電致巴使，命速令師船退出，並撤領事任。

translations.literal: At that time the German chancellor was Bismarck; he telegraphed the minister in China ordering the warships withdrawn at once and the consul dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Bismarck telegraphed von Brandt to withdraw the warships immediately and dismiss the consul.

sentences.zh: 已，德使歸咎中國地方官，屢請派員查辦，議久不決。

translations.literal: Thereafter the German minister blamed local Chinese officials and repeatedly asked that officers be sent to investigate; negotiations dragged on without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Von Brandt then blamed local Chinese officials and repeatedly demanded an investigation; talks dragged on unresolved.

sentences.zh: 至是，總署從李鴻章議，令赫德派洋員會同粵員議辦，遂辦結。

translations.literal: At this point the Foreign Office, following Li Hongzhang's proposal, ordered Hart to send foreign staff together with Guangdong officers to settle it; the case was then concluded.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen then followed Li Hongzhang's proposal and had Hart assign foreign staff to settle the matter jointly with Guangdong officials.

sentences.zh: 十年，贈德皇景泰窯器，答歷次派員監造鐵艦、撥借魚雷及兵船教習等事，修好也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year China presented the German emperor with Jingdezhen porcelain, in return for successive missions to supervise construction of ironclads, loans of torpedoes, and instruction on warships—renewing friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year China presented Jingdezhen porcelain to the German emperor in acknowledgment of ironclad construction supervision, torpedo loans, and naval instruction—renewing amity.

sentences.zh: 十二年春二月，出使英國大臣曾紀澤將回華，德駐英公使伯爵哈子斐爾德遣參贊官伯爵美塔尼克來言，德皇暨德相畢斯馬克欲與晤談，邀臨其國，遂遊各製造局廠。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, second month, Zeng Jize, minister to Britain, was about to return to China; the German minister in London, Count Hatzfeldt, sent Counsellor Count Metternich to say that the German emperor and Chancellor Bismarck wished to meet him and invited him to visit their country, whereupon he toured the various factories.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, as Minister Zeng Jize was returning from Britain, German Minister Count Hatzfeldt sent Counsellor Count Metternich to invite him to meet the Kaiser and Bismarck and tour Germany's factories.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋七月，德皇薨，命出使大臣洪鈞弔唁，德命駐華公使巴蘭德致謝。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, autumn, seventh month, the German emperor died; the court ordered Minister Hong Jun to offer condolences, and Germany ordered Minister Brandt in China to return thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Guangxu 14, the German emperor died; China sent Minister Hong Jun to offer condolences, and Germany had von Brandt convey thanks.

sentences.zh: 二十年夏四月，德人阿爾和欲在漢口建火油池。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, summer, fourth month, the German Arhe wished to build a kerosene depot at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Guangxu 20, a German named Arhe sought to build a kerosene depot at Hankou.

sentences.zh: 初，德商在上海創設火油池棧，許之。

translations.literal: Initially German merchants had been permitted to establish kerosene depots and warehouses in Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: German merchants had earlier been permitted to establish kerosene depots in Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 既又欲於漢口購地踵建，不許。

translations.literal: They now also wished to purchase land at Hankou and build likewise; this was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: When they sought to do the same at Hankou, permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 德使爭辯，旋議將火油照巿價收買，及償造油制器各費，德使仍不從。

translations.literal: The German minister argued; soon it was proposed to buy the kerosene at market price and compensate the costs of oil-making equipment, but the German minister still would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The German minister protested; China then offered to buy the kerosene at market price and compensate equipment costs, but he still refused.

sentences.zh: 明年，又請增開天津、漢口租界，許之。

translations.literal: The following year he again asked to enlarge the concessions at Tianjin and Hankou; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he secured enlargement of the Tianjin and Hankou concessions.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月，德外部馬沙爾求在中國借地泊船，出使大臣許景澄以告。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, the German foreign minister Marschall asked to lease land in China for mooring ships; Minister Xu Jingcheng reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, Guangxu 22, Foreign Minister Marschall asked to lease land in China for naval anchorage; Minister Xu Jingcheng reported it.

sentences.zh: 時李鴻章使德將還，留稅務司德璀琳與德外部商辦加稅事，德廷謂須中國讓給兵船埠地始允加稅，德璀琳阻之，不省。

translations.literal: At that time Li Hongzhang, on mission to Germany, was about to return; he left Customs Commissioner Detring to negotiate tariff increases with the German foreign office. The German court said China must grant a naval anchorage before it would agree to raise tariffs; Detring blocked this and they would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: As Li Hongzhang was returning from Germany he left Detring to negotiate tariff increases; Berlin demanded a naval anchorage in return, which Detring opposed, and Germany would not relent.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十月，山東曹州府钜野縣有暴徒殺德教士二人，德以兵艦入膠州灣，逼守將章高元退出砲台，佔領之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, rioters in Juye county, Caozhou prefecture, Shandong, killed two German missionaries; Germany sent warships into Jiaozhou Bay, forced the garrison commander Zhang Gaoyuan to abandon the forts, and occupied them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Guangxu 23 rioters in Juye, Shandong, killed two German missionaries; Germany sent warships into Jiaozhou Bay, forced Commander Zhang Gaoyuan to abandon the forts, and occupied them.

sentences.zh: 德使海靖向總署要求六款：一，革巡撫李秉衡職，永不敘用；

translations.literal: The German minister Heyking demanded six articles of the Foreign Office: first, dismiss Governor Li Bingheng from office and never employ him again;
translations.idiomatic: Minister Heyking demanded six concessions of the Yamen: first, dismiss Governor Li Bingheng and never employ him again;

sentences.zh: 二，給天主堂建築費六萬六千兩，賠償盜竊物品銀三千兩；

translations.literal: second, pay sixty-six thousand taels for construction of the Catholic church and three thousand taels of silver for stolen goods;
translations.idiomatic: second, pay sixty-six thousand taels for church construction and three thousand taels for stolen property;

sentences.zh: 三，钜野、菏澤、鄆城、單縣、曹縣、魚台、武涉七處，各建教師住房，共給工費二萬四千兩；

translations.literal: third, at seven places—Juye, Heze, Yuncheng, Shan county, Cao county, Yutai, and Wushe—build residences for missionaries, paying twenty-four thousand taels in construction costs in all;
translations.idiomatic: third, build missionary residences at seven counties—Juye, Heze, Yuncheng, Shan, Cao, Yutai, and Wushe—for twenty-four thousand taels in all;

sentences.zh: 四，保以後永無此等事件；

translations.literal: fourth, guarantee that such incidents would never occur again;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, guarantee that such incidents would never recur;

sentences.zh: 五，以兩國人資本設立德華公司，築造山東全省鐵道，並許開採鐵道附近之礦山；

translations.literal: fifth, establish a Sino-German company with capital from both countries to build railways throughout Shandong and permit mining of minerals near the lines;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, establish a joint Sino-German company to build railways throughout Shandong and mine along the lines;

sentences.zh: 六，德國辦理此案費用，均由中國賠償。

translations.literal: sixth, all costs incurred by Germany in handling the case were to be compensated by China.
translations.idiomatic: sixth, China was to pay all German costs in handling the case.

sentences.zh: 總署屢與折沖，始將第一款「永不敘用」四字刪去；

translations.literal: The Foreign Office negotiated repeatedly and finally had the four characters "never employ again" deleted from the first article;
translations.idiomatic: After repeated negotiation the Yamen had "never employ again" struck from the first article;

sentences.zh: 二、三兩款全允；

translations.literal: the second and third articles were fully granted;
translations.idiomatic: the second and third were fully accepted;

sentences.zh: 四、六兩款全削除；

translations.literal: the fourth and sixth were entirely deleted;
translations.idiomatic: the fourth and sixth were dropped entirely;

sentences.zh: 五款許以膠州灣至濟南府一段鐵道由德築造。

translations.literal: the fifth was allowed only as a railway from Jiaozhou Bay to Jinan prefecture to be built by Germany.
translations.idiomatic: the fifth was limited to a German-built railway from Jiaozhou Bay to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 議漸就緒，忽曹州有驅逐教師、殺害洋人之說，德使復要求租借膠州灣。

translations.literal: Negotiations were nearing completion when suddenly reports came from Caozhou of expelling teachers and killing foreigners; the German minister again demanded a lease of Jiaozhou Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Talks were nearly complete when reports of attacks on missionaries in Caozhou led Heyking to demand a lease of Jiaozhou Bay.

sentences.zh: 二十四年二月，總署與德使海靖另訂專條三章。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year the Foreign Office and Minister Heyking separately concluded a special agreement of three chapters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 24 the Yamen and Heyking concluded a separate three-chapter agreement.

sentences.zh: 一章，膠州灣租界：一，灣內各島嶼及灣口與口外海面之群島，又灣東北岸自陰島東北角起劃一線東南行至勞山灣止，灣西南岸自齊伯山島對岸劃一線西南行至笛羅山島止，又灣內全水面以最高潮為標之地，皆為租借區域；

translations.literal: Chapter one, Jiaozhou Bay lease: first, all islands within the bay and the archipelagos at the mouth and outside the mouth, and on the northeast shore from the northeast corner of Yin Island a line drawn southeast to Laoshan Bay, and on the southwest shore from opposite Qibo Mountain Island a line drawn southwest to Diluo Mountain Island, and all waters within the bay up to the high-tide mark, were lease territory;
translations.idiomatic: Chapter one, the Jiaozhou Bay lease: all islands in the bay and at its mouth, the northeast shore from Yin Island southeast to Laoshan Bay, the southwest shore from opposite Qibo Mountain southwest to Diluo Mountain, and all waters to the high-tide mark constituted the leased area;

sentences.zh: 二，租借區域，德國得行使主權、建築砲台等事，但不得轉租與他國；

translations.literal: second, within the leased area Germany might exercise sovereignty, build forts, and the like, but might not sublease to other states;
translations.idiomatic: second, Germany might exercise sovereignty and build fortifications in the leased area but could not sublease to other powers;

sentences.zh: 中國軍艦商船來往，均照德國所定各國往來船舶章程一例待遇；

translations.literal: Chinese warships and merchant vessels coming and going were all to be treated alike under the regulations Germany set for vessels of all nations;
translations.idiomatic: Chinese warships and merchant vessels were to be treated under Germany's regulations for all nations' shipping;

sentences.zh: 三，租借期限以九十九年為期，如限內還中國，則德國在膠州灣所用款項由中國償還，另以相當地域讓與德國；

translations.literal: third, the lease term was ninety-nine years; if within the term it were returned to China, Germany's expenditures at Jiaozhou Bay would be repaid by China and an equivalent territory granted to Germany;
translations.idiomatic: third, the lease was for ninety-nine years; if returned to China before expiry, China would repay German expenditures and grant equivalent territory elsewhere;

sentences.zh: 四，自膠州灣水面潮平點起，周圍中里一百里之陸地為中立地，主權雖歸中國，然中國若備屯軍隊，須先得德國許可，但德國軍隊有自由通過之權。

translations.literal: fourth, from the mean tide level of Jiaozhou Bay outward, land within one hundred Chinese miles in circumference was neutral territory; sovereignty remained China's, but if China stationed troops it must first obtain German permission, while German troops had the right of free passage.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, land within one hundred Chinese miles of the bay's mean tide level was a neutral zone under Chinese sovereignty, but China could not station troops without German consent while German troops enjoyed free passage.

sentences.zh: 二章，鐵道礦務辦法：一，中國准德國在山東築造自膠州灣經濰縣、青州等處至濟南及山東界，又自膠州灣至沂州經萊蕪至濟南之二鐵道；

translations.literal: Chapter two, railway and mining provisions: first, China permitted Germany to build in Shandong two railways—from Jiaozhou Bay via Weixian, Qingzhou, and other places to Jinan and the Shandong border, and from Jiaozhou Bay via Yizhou and Laiwu to Jinan;
translations.idiomatic: Chapter two, railways and mines: China permitted two German railways in Shandong—from Jiaozhou Bay via Weixian and Qingzhou to Jinan and the provincial border, and from Jiaozhou Bay via Yizhou and Laiwu to Jinan;

sentences.zh: 二，鐵道附近左右各三十里中國里內之礦產，德商有開採之權。

translations.literal: second, within thirty Chinese miles on either side of the railways German merchants had the right to mine minerals.
translations.idiomatic: second, German merchants had mining rights within thirty Chinese miles on either side of the railways.

sentences.zh: 三章，山東全省開辦各項事務：一，以後山東省內開辦何項事務，或須外資，或須外料，或聘外人，德國有侭先承辦之權。

translations.literal: Chapter three, undertakings throughout Shandong: first, whenever any enterprise was opened in Shandong hereafter, whether requiring foreign capital, foreign materials, or foreign employees, Germany had the preferential right to undertake it.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter three, enterprises in Shandong: whenever any project requiring foreign capital, materials, or personnel was launched in the province, Germany had preferential contracting rights.

sentences.zh: 是為中德膠澳租界條約。

translations.literal: This was the Sino-German Jiaozhou lease treaty.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Sino-German Jiaozhou Bay lease treaty.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，山東日照教案起，德人進兵據城，案結仍不退。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year a missionary case arose at Rizhao in Shandong; Germans sent troops and seized the city; even after the case was settled they still did not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 a missionary incident at Rizhao led German troops to occupy the city; they remained even after the case was settled.

sentences.zh: 又中國擬修天津至鎮江鐵路，德人阻之，並欲自修濟南至沂州一段，總署不許。

translations.literal: China also planned to build a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang; Germans obstructed it and also wished to build the section from Jinan to Yizhou themselves; the Foreign Office did not allow this.
translations.idiomatic: China's plan for a Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway was blocked by Germany, which also sought to build the Jinan–Yizhou section itself; the Yamen refused.

sentences.zh: 又要求中國借德款，用德工程師。

translations.literal: They also asked China to borrow German funds and employ German engineers.
translations.idiomatic: Germany also demanded that China borrow German funds and employ German engineers.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，山東高密民人阻德人修鐵路，山東巡撫袁世凱諭解之，因立鐵路章程，設華商德商膠濟鐵路公司，立交涉局，招股購地丈量建築。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the people of Gaomi in Shandong obstructed German railway construction; Shandong governor Yuan Shikai admonished and dispersed them, whereupon railway regulations were drawn up, a Sino-German Jiaoji Railway Company was established, a negotiations office was set up, and shares were sold to purchase land, survey, and build.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25 Gaomi residents blocked railway construction; Governor Yuan Shikai pacified them, drew up regulations, established the Sino-German Jiaoji Railway Company and a negotiations office, and began land purchase, surveying, and construction.

sentences.zh: 又立膠澳交涉章程十一款：一，兩國交涉案件，須兩國會辦；

translations.literal: Eleven articles of regulations for Jiaozhou negotiations were also drawn up: first, cases between the two countries must be handled jointly by both;
translations.idiomatic: Eleven articles governing Jiaozhou affairs were also adopted: first, cases between the two countries must be handled jointly;

sentences.zh: 二，德人遊歷，須發護照；

translations.literal: second, Germans traveling must be issued passports;
translations.idiomatic: second, Germans traveling inland must carry passports;

sentences.zh: 三，兩國交涉事，統由交涉官商辦；

translations.literal: third, matters between the two countries were uniformly handled by negotiation officers;
translations.idiomatic: third, all bilateral affairs were handled by negotiation officers;

sentences.zh: 四，青島租界內華洋案件，歸交涉官提訊審斷；

translations.literal: fourth, Chinese and foreign cases within the Qingdao concession were tried and judged by negotiation officers;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, mixed cases within the Qingdao concession were tried by negotiation officers;

sentences.zh: 五，租界內華人牽涉德人案件，須德官會同山東交涉官審問；

translations.literal: fifth, cases within the concession in which Chinese were involved with Germans required German officials to sit jointly with Shandong negotiation officers in examination;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, cases involving Chinese and Germans in the concession required joint examination by German and Shandong officials;

sentences.zh: 六，德雇用華民之案，須由德官審訊；

translations.literal: sixth, cases of Germans employing Chinese subjects must be tried by German officials;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, cases involving Germans employing Chinese were tried by German officials;

sentences.zh: 七，華人案件，仍由華審斷；

translations.literal: seventh, cases involving only Chinese were still judged by Chinese authorities;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, cases involving only Chinese remained under Chinese jurisdiction;

sentences.zh: 八，租界外罪犯逃入青島華民及德人住處者，分別由華官、德官提拏解交；

translations.literal: eighth, criminals outside the concession fleeing into Qingdao Chinese or German residences were to be seized and handed over respectively by Chinese or German officials;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, fugitives from outside the concession fleeing to Chinese or German residences in Qingdao were to be arrested and handed over by the respective authorities;

sentences.zh: 九，華、德人在租界內外行兇，華、德兵均可拿禁解交；

translations.literal: ninth, when Chinese or Germans committed violence inside or outside the concession, Chinese or German troops might arrest and hand them over;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, Chinese or German troops might arrest and hand over Chinese or Germans committing violence inside or outside the concession;

sentences.zh: 十，華、德官商辦案件，須和衷；

translations.literal: tenth, Chinese and German officials handling cases must act in harmony;
translations.idiomatic: tenth, Chinese and German officials must cooperate harmoniously;

sentences.zh: 十一，重大案件，本省不能結者，由總署及駐京德使商辦。

translations.literal: eleventh, major cases the province could not settle were to be negotiated by the Foreign Office and the German minister in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, major cases the province could not settle were referred to the Yamen and the German minister in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 又與德議立礦務章程，未定，二十六年五月，駐京德使克林德為拳匪所戕。

translations.literal: Negotiations with Germany on mining regulations were also unfinished; in the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year the German minister in Beijing, Ketteler, was killed by Boxers.
translations.idiomatic: Talks on mining regulations remained unsettled when, in the fifth month of Guangxu 26, Minister Ketteler was killed by Boxers.

sentences.zh: 七月，德與英、法、俄、美、日本、荷蘭、意、比、奧、瑞十一國聯軍入北京，推德將瓦德西為總司令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Germany joined Britain, France, Russia, America, Japan, the Netherlands, Italy, Belgium, Austria, and Sweden in an allied army entering Beijing, and the German general Waldersee was made commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Germany joined ten other powers in an allied expedition to Beijing and made General Waldersee commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 瓦德西入居禁城儀鑾殿。

translations.literal: Waldersee took up residence in the Hall of Imperial Splendor within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: Waldersee moved into the Hall of Imperial Splendor in the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 時命李鴻章為全權大臣，入京議和。

translations.literal: At the time Li Hongzhang was appointed plenipotentiary minister to enter the capital and negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was then appointed plenipotentiary minister and sent to Beijing to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 各國提出條款：一，中國政府為被戕德公使克林德置立石碑；

translations.literal: The powers proposed terms: first, the Chinese government was to erect a stone monument for the murdered German envoy Ketteler;
translations.idiomatic: The powers put forward terms: first, the Chinese government was to erect a stone monument to the murdered German envoy Ketteler;

sentences.zh: 一，中國政府應派親王前往德國謝罪；

translations.literal: second, the Chinese government should dispatch a prince to Germany to offer an apology;
translations.idiomatic: second, the Chinese government was to send a prince to Germany to apologize;

sentences.zh: 一，將總理衙門撤去；

translations.literal: third, the Zongli Yamen was to be abolished;
translations.idiomatic: third, the Zongli Yamen was to be abolished;

sentences.zh: 一，嚴辦禍首；

translations.literal: fourth, the ringleaders were to be severely punished;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, the ringleaders were to be severely punished;

sentences.zh: 一，廢去大沽口及直隸各處砲台；

translations.literal: fifth, the forts at Dagu and elsewhere in Zhili were to be dismantled;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, the forts at Dagu and elsewhere in Zhili were to be dismantled;

sentences.zh: 一，禁止軍裝砲火入口；

translations.literal: sixth, the import of military arms and munitions was to be forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, the import of military arms and munitions was to be prohibited;

sentences.zh: 一，各省有曾經殺戮西人，停止鄉試小考五年；

translations.literal: seventh, in provinces where Westerners had been killed, provincial and lower examinations were to be suspended for five years;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, in provinces where Westerners had been killed, provincial and lower civil examinations were to be suspended for five years;

sentences.zh: 一，有事直達中國皇上；

translations.literal: eighth, matters were to be communicated directly to the Chinese emperor;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, communications were to go directly to the Chinese emperor;

sentences.zh: 一，駐華各使館永遠設兵保護；

translations.literal: ninth, legations in China were permanently to be guarded by troops;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, the legations in China were to be permanently guarded by troops;

sentences.zh: 一，由京至海電報郵政設兵保護；

translations.literal: tenth, telegraph and postal lines from the capital to the sea were to be guarded by troops;
translations.idiomatic: tenth, telegraph and postal routes from Beijing to the coast were to be guarded by troops;

sentences.zh: 一，國家公司以及私產均照賠。

translations.literal: eleventh, state, company, and private property alike were to be fully indemnified.
translations.idiomatic: eleventh, state, corporate, and private property alike were to be fully indemnified.

sentences.zh: 久之始定議，共十二款，而為克林德立碑京城，及遣醇王載灃入德謝罪，均如所請行。

translations.literal: After long delay agreement was finally reached in twelve articles; erecting a monument to Ketteler in the capital and sending Prince Chun Zaifeng to Germany to apologize were both carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged negotiation twelve articles were finally agreed; the Ketteler monument in the capital and Prince Chun Zaifeng's apology mission to Germany were both carried out as demanded.

sentences.zh: 十月，獲戕德使克林德犯恩海，交德駐京提督誅之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month En Hai, the man who had killed Minister Ketteler, was apprehended and handed to the German commander in Beijing, who executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month En Hai, who had killed Minister Ketteler, was captured and handed over to the German commander in Beijing for execution.

sentences.zh: 明年，醇親王載灃至德，見德皇遞書，時帶廕昌一人，俱行鞠躬禮。

translations.literal: The following year Prince Chun Zaifeng arrived in Germany, met the Kaiser and presented a letter; he was accompanied by Yinchang alone, and both performed the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Prince Chun Zaifeng reached Germany, met the Kaiser, and delivered a letter; accompanied only by Yinchang, both performed the bow.

sentences.zh: 二十八年秋七月，德商在漢口華界偪近襄河口請設立躉船，駮之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn in the twenty-eighth year, German merchants requested to establish a depot ship near the Xiang River mouth in the Chinese quarter of Hankou; this was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Guangxu 28, German merchants asked to moor a depot ship near the Xiang River mouth in Hankou's Chinese quarter; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 時政府要求德及英、法、日本撤兵，德使聞他國有在揚子江獨享中國特予權利者，請定明長江上下游進兵要隘不得讓與他國，以定撤兵日期，拒之。

translations.literal: At the time the government requested Germany, Britain, France, and Japan to withdraw troops; the German minister, hearing that other countries had been granted exclusive Chinese privileges on the Yangtze, asked that it be stipulated that strategic points on the upper and lower Yangtze for troop advance must not be ceded to other powers, as a condition for fixing a withdrawal date; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: The government then pressed Germany, Britain, France, and Japan to withdraw their troops. Learning that other powers held exclusive Yangtze privileges, the German minister asked that strategic points on the upper and lower river be barred from transfer to third countries as a condition for setting a withdrawal date; China refused.

sentences.zh: 三十年，與德會訂小清河岔路合同。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year a contract on the Xiaoqing River branch line was jointly concluded with Germany.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 China and Germany jointly concluded a contract for the Xiaoqing River branch line.

sentences.zh: 初，膠濟鐵路章程原不許擅行另造枝路，今為商務便利計，特委膠濟鐵路公司代辦。

translations.literal: Initially the Jiaoji Railway regulations did not permit unauthorized construction of branch lines; now, for commercial convenience, the Jiaoji Railway Company was specially entrusted to handle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaoji Railway regulations had originally forbidden unauthorized branch lines; for commercial convenience the work was now entrusted to the Jiaoji Railway Company.

sentences.zh: 是年，德水艦隊擬入長江及各內河遊巡演砲，阻之。

translations.literal: That year the German naval squadron planned to enter the Yangtze and various inland rivers to cruise and conduct gunnery drills; this was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Germany planned to send its naval squadron up the Yangtze and inland rivers for cruises and gunnery drills; China blocked the plan.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，德撤退膠州、高密兩處兵隊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Germany withdrew troops from Jiaozhou and Gaomi.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 Germany withdrew its garrisons from Jiaozhou and Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 初，德人在山東修造膠濟鐵路，因高密民聚眾阻工，先後由青島派兵赴膠、高保護鐵路。

translations.literal: Initially, when Germans built the Jiaoji Railway in Shandong, the people of Gaomi gathered to obstruct the work; troops were repeatedly sent from Qingdao to Jiaozhou and Gaomi to protect the railway.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiaoji Railway was first built in Shandong, Gaomi residents massed to obstruct the work, and troops were repeatedly dispatched from Qingdao to Jiaozhou and Gaomi to guard the line.

sentences.zh: 山東巡撫袁世凱派員查辦議結，駐膠德兵旋即撤回青島。

translations.literal: Shandong governor Yuan Shikai sent officials to investigate and negotiate a settlement, and the German troops stationed at Jiaozhou were soon withdrawn to Qingdao.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Yuan Shikai of Shandong sent officials to investigate and settle the matter, and the German troops at Jiaozhou were soon pulled back to Qingdao.

sentences.zh: 既，拳匪滋事，德人又派兵分駐膠州，並於城北車站旁價購民地十四畝，修造兵房。

translations.literal: Later, when the Boxers caused trouble, Germans again sent troops to garrison Jiaozhou, and purchased fourteen mu of civilian land beside the north station to build barracks.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer outbreak Germans again posted troops at Jiaozhou and bought fourteen mu of land beside the north station to build barracks.

sentences.zh: 二十九年秋，又于附近沈家河續租民地七畝，安設水管，以便取汲。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-ninth year they further leased seven mu of civilian land near Shenjia River and installed water pipes for drawing water.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guangxu 29 they leased seven more mu near Shenjia River and laid water pipes for supply.

sentences.zh: 高密兵隊先駐城內，後又在城外古城地方議租民地九十餘畝，修造兵房，議定以六個月為限。

translations.literal: The Gaomi garrison was first stationed inside the city; later over ninety mu of civilian land at the old city site outside the walls was leased to build barracks, fixed at a limit of six months.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaomi garrison was first housed inside the city, then leased more than ninety mu at the old town site outside the walls to build barracks, for a term fixed at six months.

sentences.zh: 尋又修築由古城至小王莊火車站馬路一道。

translations.literal: Soon a road was also built from the old city to Xiaowangzhuang railway station.
translations.idiomatic: A road was soon built from the old town to Xiaowangzhuang station.

sentences.zh: 時六個月限期已滿，東撫商令退兵，屢延展，至是始訂撤兵善後事宜五款，遂議結。

translations.literal: When the six-month limit expired the eastern governor negotiated troop withdrawal; extensions were repeatedly granted; at last five articles on withdrawal and aftermath were agreed, and the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: When the six-month term expired the governor of Shandong negotiated withdrawal; deadlines were repeatedly extended until five articles on withdrawal and follow-up were finally agreed and the affair closed.

sentences.zh: 又議商約，朝廷派呂海寰、盛宣懷為商約大臣。

translations.literal: A commercial treaty was also negotiated; the court appointed Lü Haihuan and Sheng Xuanhuai as commercial treaty commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial treaty talks followed; the court appointed Lü Haihuan and Sheng Xuanhuai as treaty commissioners.

sentences.zh: 德人提出十四款，袁世凱、張之洞往返電商，海寰等與德使穆默、總領事克納俱迭次會議，彼此堅持。

translations.literal: The Germans proposed fourteen articles; Yuan Shikai and Zhang Zhidong exchanged telegrams back and forth; Haihuan and others met repeatedly with German minister Mumm and consul-general Knorre, and both sides held firm.
translations.idiomatic: Germany proposed fourteen articles; Yuan Shikai and Zhang Zhidong exchanged telegrams; Lü Haihuan and others met repeatedly with Minister Mumm and Consul-General Knorre, and both sides held their ground.

sentences.zh: 至三十三年，始議定條約十三款，在北京互換。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year a treaty of thirteen articles was finally agreed and exchanged in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 a thirteen-article treaty was finally agreed and ratified by exchange in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 第一款，釐金：中國政府與諸國立約裁撤現有之釐金，加增進出口之關稅以抵裁釐。

translations.literal: Article 1, Likin: the Chinese government, in treaty with the various powers, was to abolish existing likin and increase import and export customs duties to offset the abolition of likin.
translations.idiomatic: Article 1, Likin: China, in treaty with the other powers, would abolish existing likin and raise import and export customs duties to compensate.

sentences.zh: 此約須立約各國派員議決，德國政府亦允派員議結此事，惟中國須當擔保釐金定必全行裁撤方可。

translations.literal: This arrangement required commissioners from all treaty powers to decide it; the German government also agreed to send commissioners to conclude the matter, but China must guarantee that likin would certainly be wholly abolished before it could proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners from all treaty powers were to decide the arrangement; Germany agreed to send its own, but only after China guaranteed the complete abolition of likin.

sentences.zh: 第二款，住居：德國人民及德國保護之人民，准在中國已開及日後所開為外國人民通商各口岸或通商地方，往來居住，辦理商工各業製造等事，以及他項合例事業；

translations.literal: Article 2, Residence: German nationals and persons under German protection were permitted to come and go, reside, and conduct commerce, industry, manufacturing, and other lawful enterprises in Chinese treaty ports already opened and those to be opened hereafter for foreign trade;
translations.idiomatic: Article 2, Residence: German nationals and persons under German protection might reside and conduct commerce, industry, manufacturing, and other lawful business in treaty ports already open and in those later opened to foreign trade;

sentences.zh: 且准租買房屋、地基、經商之地及他項實產，並可在租買之地內建造房屋。

translations.literal: they were also permitted to lease and purchase houses, foundations, land for business, and other real property, and to build houses on leased or purchased land.
translations.idiomatic: they might also lease or purchase houses, land, business premises, and other real property, and erect buildings on land so acquired.

sentences.zh: 第三款，關棧：中國政府允准在通商口岸設法屯積洋貨及拆包改裝等事。

translations.literal: Article 3, Bonded warehouses: the Chinese government agreed to provide means at treaty ports for storing foreign goods and for unpacking and repacking.
translations.idiomatic: Article 3, Bonded warehouses: China agreed to establish facilities at treaty ports for storing foreign goods and for unpacking and repacking.

sentences.zh: 中國政府一經由德領事請將某德商或德國保護人民之棧得享關棧之利益，則中國政府須准如所請，惟須遵照海關所訂之專章辦理，以保餉源。

translations.literal: Once the Chinese government received a request from the German consul that a warehouse of a German merchant or person under German protection should enjoy bonded-warehouse benefits, the Chinese government must grant the request, but only in accordance with special regulations laid down by the customs to safeguard revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Upon request from the German consul, China was to grant bonded-warehouse status to warehouses of German merchants or protected persons, subject to customs regulations designed to protect revenue.

sentences.zh: 海關官員又須與各國領事議定關棧專章，以及規費若干，須按照該棧離關遠近，屯何貨物，並工作早晚，酌量核定。

translations.literal: Customs officials were also to agree with the various consuls on special regulations for bonded warehouses and on the fees to be charged, which were to be fixed with due regard to distance from the customs house, the goods stored, and the hours of work.
translations.idiomatic: Customs was to agree with the consuls on bonded-warehouse regulations and fees, adjusted for distance from the customs house, the goods stored, and hours of operation.

sentences.zh: 凡在通商地方所設之關棧，德國人民及德國保護人民均准用之。

translations.literal: All bonded warehouses established in treaty areas might be used by German nationals and persons under German protection.
translations.idiomatic: German nationals and protected persons might use all bonded warehouses established in treaty areas.

sentences.zh: 第四款，礦務：中國政府振興礦務，並招徠外洋資本興辦礦業，故允自簽押此約之日起，於一年內，仿照德國及他國現行礦務章程，頒發礦務新章，以期一面振興中國人民之利益，於中國主權毫無妨礙，一面於招致外洋資財無礙，且比較諸國通行章程，於礦商亦不致有虧。

translations.literal: Article 4, Mining: as the Chinese government sought to promote mining and attract foreign capital to develop the industry, it agreed that within one year from the signing of this treaty it would promulgate new mining regulations modeled on current German and other foreign mining codes, so as to advance the interests of the Chinese people without impairing Chinese sovereignty, to facilitate the attraction of foreign capital, and to ensure that miners would not fare worse than under the regulations generally applied by other countries.
translations.idiomatic: Article 4, Mining: to promote mining and attract foreign capital, China agreed to issue new mining regulations within one year of signing, modeled on German and other foreign codes—advancing Chinese interests without impairing sovereignty, welcoming foreign investment, and treating miners no worse than under other countries' standard rules.

sentences.zh: 是以中國政府須准德國人民及德國保護人民在中國地方開辦礦務及礦務內所應辦之事。

translations.literal: Accordingly the Chinese government must permit German nationals and persons under German protection to undertake mining and all operations incidental thereto in Chinese territory.
translations.idiomatic: China therefore had to permit German nationals and protected persons to conduct mining and related operations on Chinese soil.

sentences.zh: 凡所辦礦業，不得因稅項之故致其財源有所虧損，除徵抽淨利之稅及礦產之地稅外，不得另抽他項之稅。

translations.literal: No mining enterprise was to suffer loss of revenue because of taxation; apart from taxes on net profits and land taxes on mineral property, no other taxes might be levied.
translations.idiomatic: Mining enterprises were not to be burdened by taxation beyond taxes on net profits and land taxes on mineral property; no other levies were permitted.

sentences.zh: 第五款，貨稅：還稅之存票，須自商人稟請之日起，如查系應領者，限於二十一日內由海關發給。

translations.literal: Article 5, Duties: duty-refund deposit certificates must, from the date of the merchant's application, be issued by the customs within twenty-one days if found due.
translations.idiomatic: Article 5, Duties: duty-refund deposit certificates were to be issued by customs within twenty-one days of application when found due.

sentences.zh: 此等存票，可用在各處海關，按所載銀數，除子口稅一項外，以抵各項出入口貨稅。

translations.literal: Such certificates might be used at customs offices everywhere to offset all import and export duties according to the silver amount stated, except for transit duty.
translations.idiomatic: These certificates could be used at any customs office to offset import and export duties up to the stated amount, except transit duty.

sentences.zh: 至洋貨入口後三年之內，轉運外洋，凡執持此等存票者，即准任便在發給之港向海關銀號按全數領取現銀。

translations.literal: If foreign goods were re-exported within three years of entry, holders of such certificates might freely receive the full amount in cash from the customs bank at the port of issue.
translations.idiomatic: If foreign goods were re-exported within three years of entry, certificate holders might collect the full amount in cash from the customs bank at the issuing port.

sentences.zh: 倘請發存票之人意圖走漏關稅，一經查出，則須罰銀，照其所圖騙之數不得逾五倍，或將其貨入官。

translations.literal: If an applicant for such a certificate was found intent on evading customs duty, a fine of up to five times the amount sought to be defrauded was to be imposed, or the goods were to be confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone found seeking a certificate to evade customs duty faced a fine of up to five times the amount defrauded, or confiscation of the goods.

sentences.zh: 第六款，保護商標：凡中國商標，一經呈出在中國各領事所給之據，證明此項商標已在中國認可，且實屬於稟請之人者，均可在德國享保護之利益，與德國之商標相同。

translations.literal: Article 6, Trademark protection: every Chinese trademark, once documentary proof from a consul in China was presented showing that the mark had been recognized in China and truly belonged to the applicant, might enjoy in Germany the same protection as a German trademark.
translations.idiomatic: Article 6, Trademarks: Chinese trademarks certified by a consul in China as registered and belonging to the applicant were to enjoy in Germany the same protection as German marks.

sentences.zh: 華商之姓名牌號，必須在德國保護，以免仿冒。

translations.literal: Chinese merchants' names and trade marks must be protected in Germany to prevent imitation.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese merchants' names and trade marks had to be protected in Germany against imitation.

sentences.zh: 德國商標亦須在中國保護，以防假冒，惟須呈出德國官員並領事所給之據，證明該商標實已在德國註冊，德商之姓名商標以及中國行名均須保護。

translations.literal: German trademarks must also be protected in China against counterfeiting, but proof from German officials and the consul showing that the mark was actually registered in Germany must be presented; German merchants' names and trademarks and Chinese trade names were all to be protected.
translations.idiomatic: German trademarks were likewise to be protected in China against counterfeiting on proof of German registration; German merchants' names and marks and Chinese trade names were all protected.

sentences.zh: 凡德商包裹貨物之特法，在中國之同業曾已認為某行用以區別某項貨物者，亦須一律保護。

translations.literal: Any special method by which German merchants wrapped goods, if recognized by the trade in China as a firm's mark to distinguish certain goods, was also to be protected uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: Distinctive German packaging recognized in China as identifying a firm's goods was also to be protected.

sentences.zh: 德國保護之人民亦能享以上所言之利益。

translations.literal: Persons under German protection might also enjoy the benefits stated above.
translations.idiomatic: Persons under German protection enjoyed the same benefits.

sentences.zh: 商標註冊局一經成立，保護商標章程亦已刊佈，則中、德兩國必須開議特約，以便彼此保護商標。

translations.literal: Once trademark registration offices were established and trademark protection regulations published, China and Germany must open negotiations on a special convention for mutual trademark protection.
translations.idiomatic: Once trademark offices were established and regulations published, China and Germany were to negotiate a special convention for mutual protection.

sentences.zh: 至此約未議之前，以上之款必須施行。

translations.literal: Until that convention was negotiated, the above provisions must be enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Until such a convention was concluded, the above provisions remained in force.

sentences.zh: 第七款，營業：中國人民購買他國營業及公司之股票，是否合例，尚未明定。

translations.literal: Article 7, Business operations: whether Chinese nationals might lawfully purchase shares in foreign businesses and companies had not yet been clearly defined.
translations.idiomatic: Article 7, Business: whether Chinese nationals could lawfully buy shares in foreign firms had not yet been settled.

sentences.zh: 又因華民如此購買，為數頗巨，故中國現將華民或已購買或將來購買他國公司股票，均認為合例。

translations.literal: Because such purchases by Chinese had become considerable in number, China now recognized as lawful both past and future purchases by Chinese nationals of shares in foreign companies.
translations.idiomatic: Because such purchases had grown substantially, China now recognized past and future Chinese purchases of foreign company shares as lawful.

sentences.zh: 凡同一合資公司，原入股購票者，彼此一律，不得稍有歧異。

translations.literal: In any given joint-stock company, original subscribers were to be treated alike without the slightest distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Within any joint-stock company, original shareholders were to be treated identically.

sentences.zh: 遇有華民購買德公司股份者，應將該人民購買股份之舉，即作為已允遵守該公司訂定法律章程，並原按德國公堂解釋該法律章程辦法之據。

translations.literal: When a Chinese national purchased shares in a German company, that purchase was to be taken as consent to abide by the company's governing statutes and as acceptance of their interpretation according to German courts.
translations.idiomatic: A Chinese national's purchase of German company shares constituted acceptance of the company's statutes and of their interpretation under German law.

sentences.zh: 倘不遵辦，致被公司控告，中國公堂應即飭令買股份之華民遵守該章程，當與德國公堂飭令買股份之德國人民相等無異，不得另有苛求。

translations.literal: If he failed to comply and was sued by the company, Chinese courts must at once order the Chinese shareholder to observe the statutes, on the same terms as German courts would order a German shareholder, without additional demands.
translations.idiomatic: If sued for noncompliance, Chinese courts were to compel the Chinese shareholder to observe the statutes on the same terms as German courts would apply to German shareholders, without extra conditions.

sentences.zh: 德國人民如購中國公司股票，其當守本分，與華民之有股份者相同。

translations.literal: If German nationals purchased shares in Chinese companies, they were to observe the same obligations as Chinese shareholders.
translations.idiomatic: German nationals buying shares in Chinese companies owed the same duties as Chinese shareholders.

sentences.zh: 凡尋常合資股東，及一人或數人有無限之責任，與一人或數人有有限之責任，為合資股東，在德屬經商之有限合資公司註冊，合辦會社有限公司，及各項商業公司等，均須按照以上二節辦理。

translations.literal: Ordinary partners, partners with unlimited liability, and partners with limited liability in limited partnerships registered in Germany, joint-stock companies, and other commercial firms were all to be governed by the two preceding paragraphs.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary partners, unlimited-liability partners, limited-liability partners in German limited partnerships, joint-stock companies, and other commercial firms were all subject to the two preceding paragraphs.

sentences.zh: 茲並訂明，本約告成之時，凡曾經呈控公堂而由公堂判定，及不予准理之案，均與是款無涉。

translations.literal: It was further stipulated that cases already adjudicated or dismissed by courts when this treaty was concluded were not affected by this article.
translations.idiomatic: Cases already decided or dismissed by courts when the treaty took effect were excluded from this article.

sentences.zh: 第八款，開埠：凡各國代其本國人民船舶索開之口岸地方，德國商人與德國保護之人民，及德國船舶，均可共用此益。

translations.literal: Article 8, Opening of ports: wherever any country obtained the opening of a port or place for its nationals' vessels, German merchants, persons under German protection, and German vessels might share the same benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Article 8, Treaty ports: wherever any power secured the opening of a port for its nationals' vessels, German merchants, protected persons, and German ships shared the benefit.

sentences.zh: 第九款，行船：中國本知宜昌至重慶一帶水道宜加整頓，以便輪船行駛，所以彼此訂定，未能整頓以前，應准輪船業主聽候海關核准，自行出資安設拖拉過灘利便之件。

translations.literal: Article 9, Navigation: China already knew that the waterway from Yichang to Chongqing should be improved for steam navigation; the parties therefore agreed that until improvement was completed, steamship owners might, subject to customs approval, install at their own expense appliances to assist hauling over shoals.
translations.idiomatic: Article 9, Navigation: recognizing that the Yichang–Chongqing waterway needed improvement for steam navigation, the parties agreed that until dredging was completed, steamship owners might, with customs approval, install at their own expense gear to assist passage over shoals.

sentences.zh: 其所安設利便之件，無論民船、輪船，均須遵照海關與創辦利便之人商議後所定章程辦理。

translations.literal: All such appliances, whether used by native craft or steamers, were to be operated according to regulations agreed between the customs and those who installed them.
translations.idiomatic: Use of such appliances by native craft or steamers was governed by regulations agreed between customs and the installers.

sentences.zh: 其標示記號之台塔及指示水槽之標記，由海關酌度何地相宜備設。

translations.literal: Beacon towers with marking signs and channel markers were to be placed where the customs judged appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Customs was to decide where to place beacon towers and channel markers.

sentences.zh: 將來整頓水道，及利於行船而無害于地方百姓，且不費中國國家之款，中國不宜拒阻。

translations.literal: Future improvement of the waterway that benefited navigation without harm to local people and without expense to the Chinese state was not to be obstructed by China.
translations.idiomatic: China was not to obstruct future waterway improvements that aided navigation, harmed no local interests, and cost the state nothing.

sentences.zh: 第十款，內港行船章程：前已特准在通商口岸行駛貿易，因是年七月二十八號及九月先後所訂此項章程間有未便，是以彼此訂明，從新修改。

translations.literal: Article 10, Inland navigation regulations: permission had already been granted for trade navigation at treaty ports; because regulations on this matter adopted on July 28 and in September of that year proved inconvenient in places, the parties agreed to revise them anew.
translations.idiomatic: Article 10, Inland navigation: trade navigation at treaty ports had already been authorized, but regulations adopted on July 28 and in September of that year proved awkward in places, so the parties agreed to revise them.

sentences.zh: 第十一款，圜法：中國允原設法定為合例之國幣，將來德國商人及德國保護人民並中國人民，應遵照以完納各項稅課及付一切用款。

translations.literal: Article 11, Currency: China agreed that the national coinage already established as lawful currency would in future be used by German merchants, persons under German protection, and Chinese nationals alike to pay all taxes and all sums due.
translations.idiomatic: Article 11, Currency: China agreed that the lawful national coinage would be used by German merchants, protected persons, and Chinese nationals alike for all taxes and payments.

sentences.zh: 第十二款，禁令：一千八百八十一年九月二號中德條約附載之通商章程第五款第三節內開，「凡米穀等糧，德商欲運往中國通商別口，照銅錢一律辦理」等因，茲彼此應允，若在某處，無論因何事故，如有饑荒之虞，中國政府先於二十一日前出示禁止米穀等糧由該處出口，各商自當遵辦。

translations.literal: Article 12, Prohibitions: section 3 of article 5 of the trade regulations annexed to the Sino-German treaty of September 2, 1881 provided that grain and similar foodstuffs transported by German merchants to other Chinese treaty ports were to be treated like copper cash; the parties now agreed that if at any place, for whatever reason, famine was feared, the Chinese government might, twenty-one days in advance, issue notice prohibiting export of grain and similar foodstuffs from that place, and merchants must comply.
translations.idiomatic: Article 12, Prohibitions: under the 1881 Sino-German trade regulations, grain shipped by German merchants between treaty ports was treated like copper cash; the parties now agreed that if famine was feared anywhere, China might give twenty-one days' notice banning grain exports from that place, and merchants must comply.

sentences.zh: 倘船隻為專租載運穀米，若在奉禁期前，或甫屆禁期到埠尚未裝完已買定之米穀者，仍可准於禁期七日內一律裝完出口。

translations.literal: If a vessel was specially chartered to carry grain and had arrived before the prohibition or at its start with contracted grain not yet fully loaded, loading might still be completed and export permitted within seven days of the prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels chartered for grain that arrived before the ban—or at its start with contracted cargo not yet loaded—might finish loading and export within seven days.

sentences.zh: 惟米穀禁期之內，應於示內聲明漕米、軍米有無出口。

translations.literal: During the grain prohibition the notice must state whether tribute grain and military grain would be exported.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition notice had to state whether tribute grain and military grain would be exported during the ban.

sentences.zh: 如運出口者，應於海關冊簿詳細登記進出若干，其餘他項米穀，中國政府必須設法一概不准轉運出口。

translations.literal: If such grain was exported, the amounts in and out must be recorded in detail in customs registers; all other grain the Chinese government must take measures to prevent from being transshipped for export.
translations.idiomatic: Any such exports were to be recorded in detail in customs registers; China had to block all other grain from transshipment for export.

sentences.zh: 其禁止米穀以及禁期內應運之漕米、軍米數目，各告示均須由中國政府頒發，以期共見。

translations.literal: Notices on the grain prohibition and on the amounts of tribute and military grain to be shipped during the prohibition must all be issued by the Chinese government for general knowledge.
translations.idiomatic: All notices on the grain ban and on tribute and military grain permitted during it were to be issued by the Chinese government for public notice.

sentences.zh: 二十一日之期限，必須自京報登刊之日起計。

translations.literal: The twenty-one-day period must be counted from the date of publication in the Court Gazette.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-one-day period ran from publication in the Court Gazette.

sentences.zh: 限滿弛禁之告示，亦須載於京報，使眾得聞。

translations.literal: Notices lifting the prohibition when the term expired must also appear in the Court Gazette so all might know.
translations.idiomatic: Notices lifting the ban were also to appear in the Court Gazette.

sentences.zh: 至米穀等糧，仍不准運出外國。

translations.literal: Grain and similar foodstuffs were still not permitted to be shipped abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and similar foodstuffs remained barred from export abroad.

sentences.zh: 第十三款，中、德兩國於本約以前所立各條約，除因立本約有所更改外，均仍舊施行。

translations.literal: Article 13: all treaties previously concluded between China and Germany remained in force except where altered by this treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Article 13: prior Sino-German treaties remained in force except as modified by this treaty.

sentences.zh: 嗣後如有文詞辯論之處，應以德文作為正義。

translations.literal: If disputes over wording arose hereafter, the German text was to be authoritative.
translations.idiomatic: In any future dispute over wording, the German text would govern.

sentences.zh: 是年與德訂互寄郵件暫行章程。

translations.literal: That year provisional regulations on mutual postal exchange were concluded with Germany.
translations.idiomatic: That year China and Germany concluded provisional regulations on mutual mail exchange.

sentences.zh: 訂後，德使穆默牒總稅務司聲明三事：一，高密所設之德國郵局，應俟德軍撤屯方能裁撤；

translations.literal: After the agreement Minister Mumm notified the Inspector General of Customs of three points: first, the German post office at Gaomi could be abolished only after German troops withdrew;
translations.idiomatic: After signing, Minister Mumm notified the Inspector General of three points: first, the German post office at Gaomi could close only after German troops withdrew;

sentences.zh: 二，山東一帶涉及德人之處，所有華局酌用德文人員；

translations.literal: second, in Shandong wherever German interests were involved, Chinese postal offices might employ German staff as appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: second, in Shandong wherever German interests were involved, Chinese post offices might employ German staff as appropriate;

sentences.zh: 三，山東鐵路允中國郵政得有任藉此路運送郵袋之權。

translations.literal: third, the Shandong Railway agreed to allow the Chinese post to use the line freely to transport mailbags.
translations.idiomatic: third, the Shandong Railway granted the Chinese post the right to carry mailbags over the line.

sentences.zh: 總稅務司得牒，均照允，惟酌用德文人員，謂須視有無人才，方能照辦。

translations.literal: The Inspector General received the note and agreed to all points, but regarding employment of German staff said this depended on whether suitable personnel were available.
translations.idiomatic: The Inspector General accepted all three points, but on German staff said implementation depended on finding qualified personnel.

sentences.zh: 會德人收中國商報，電政大臣袁世凱請外務部嚴禁。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Germans were intercepting Chinese commercial telegrams; Telegraph Director Yuan Shikai asked the Foreign Ministry to forbid this strictly.
translations.idiomatic: Germans were intercepting Chinese commercial telegrams; Yuan Shikai, director of telegraph affairs, asked the Foreign Ministry to forbid it.

sentences.zh: 既而德允停收商報，並允中國電報局設在山東鐵路車站。

translations.literal: Germany then agreed to stop intercepting commercial telegrams and to allow Chinese telegraph offices at Shandong Railway stations.
translations.idiomatic: Germany then agreed to stop intercepting commercial telegrams and to allow Chinese telegraph offices at Shandong Railway stations.

sentences.zh: 已，復又請由煙臺至上海線及北京至大沽行軍陸線求借用，拒之。

translations.literal: Later they again requested use of the Yantai–Shanghai line and the Beijing–Dagu military land line; both requests were refused.
translations.idiomatic: They later asked to use the Yantai–Shanghai line and the Beijing–Dagu military land line; both requests were refused.

sentences.zh: 又拒德商禮和洋行私購湖南礦產。

translations.literal: China also refused the German firm Carlowitz's private purchase of Hunan mineral property.
translations.idiomatic: China also refused Carlowitz & Co.'s private purchase of Hunan mining rights.

sentences.zh: 又德定濟南、漢口、江寧等處領事兼管各處交涉事宜，照會外務部，略謂「山東省除登州府仍歸煙臺本國領事辦理本國交涉事宜，並膠澳租地歸駐青島德國總督外，其餘所有東省本國交涉事，統歸駐濟南商辦事件委員經理。

translations.literal: Germany also fixed the consuls at Jinan, Hankou, Jiangning, and elsewhere to handle local affairs, and notified the Foreign Ministry, roughly stating: "In Shandong, except that Dengzhou prefecture remains under the German consul at Yantai for German affairs and the Jiaozhou lease under the German governor at Qingdao, all other German affairs in the eastern province are placed under the commercial commissioner stationed at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Germany also assigned consular jurisdictions at Jinan, Hankou, Jiangning, and elsewhere and notified the Foreign Ministry, in substance: "In Shandong, except Dengzhou under the Yantai consul and the Jiaozhou lease under the governor at Qingdao, all other German affairs in the province fall to the commercial commissioner at Jinan.

sentences.zh: 其煙臺本國領事官，僅有登州府本國交涉事歸其經理。

translations.literal: The German consul at Yantai handles only German affairs in Dengzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yantai consul handles only German affairs in Dengzhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又定明漢口本國領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系湖南、陝西、甘肅三省。

translations.literal: It was further fixed that the German consul at Hankou should handle German affairs in Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Hankou consul was assigned Hunan, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 湖北除歸宜昌領事辦理各府外，並江西省之袁州府等處，悉歸漢口本國領事經理。

translations.literal: In Hubei, apart from prefectures under the consul at Yichang, Yuanzhou prefecture in Jiangxi and other places all fall under the German consul at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, except prefectures under the Yichang consul, Yuanzhou in Jiangxi and related districts fall to the Hankou consul.

sentences.zh: 至駐江甯府領事應辦本國交涉事宜，系安徽、江西二省。

translations.literal: The German consul stationed at Jiangning was to handle German affairs in Anhui and Jiangxi provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The consul at Jiangning was assigned Anhui and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 除歸漢口領事之袁州府外，又江蘇省之江寧府等處」云云。

translations.literal: Apart from Yuanzhou prefecture under the Hankou consul, this includes Jiangning prefecture in Jiangsu and other places," and so on.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Yuanzhou under Hankou, this includes Jiangning in Jiangsu and related districts," and so on.

sentences.zh: 是年德福親王來京覲見。

translations.literal: That year the Duke of Saxe-Weimar came to the capital for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Duke of Saxe-Weimar came to Beijing for an audience.

sentences.zh: 德皇子婚禮，命出使德國大臣廕昌往賀，並派學生往柏林留學。

translations.literal: For the German crown prince's wedding, the envoy to Germany Yinchang was ordered to attend the celebration, and students were dispatched to study in Berlin.
translations.idiomatic: For the German crown prince's wedding, Envoy Yinchang was sent to offer congratulations, and students were dispatched to study in Berlin.

sentences.zh: 三十二年二月，德人始在津關請領聯單，赴新疆採買土貨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-second year Germans first applied at the Tianjin customs for transit certificates to go to Xinjiang to purchase native goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 32 Germans first obtained transit certificates at Tianjin customs to travel to Xinjiang and buy native goods.

sentences.zh: 三月，德使穆默牒中國，請派員往柏林商議無線電會約章，政府約二次開會再行核辦。

translations.literal: In the third month Minister Mumm notified China requesting that commissioners be sent to Berlin to negotiate a wireless telegraphy convention; the government replied that after a second meeting it would reconsider.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Minister Mumm asked China to send commissioners to Berlin to negotiate a wireless telegraphy convention; the government replied it would decide after a second session.

sentences.zh: 閏四月，德交還天津馬隊營盤等處房地，並砲隊、機器槍隊、屠牲場、養病院各房屋。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month Germany returned land and buildings at the Tianjin cavalry camp and elsewhere, as well as the buildings of the artillery, machine-gun, slaughterhouse, and hospital units.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month Germany returned the Tianjin cavalry camp and related property, along with buildings used by artillery, machine-gun, slaughterhouse, and hospital units.

sentences.zh: 是月，德在營口改設正領事。

translations.literal: That month Germany upgraded its post at Yingkou to a full consulate.
translations.idiomatic: That month Germany upgraded its Yingkou post to a full consulate.

sentences.zh: 德使穆默回國，署使葛爾士牒中國，復以通商口岸限制洋人置地辦法與條約不符，請除限制，並謂德人地產收回公用，可會商。

translations.literal: Minister Mumm returned home; the chargé d'affaires von Gerold sent a note to China again arguing that restrictions on foreigners' land purchases at treaty ports did not accord with treaty and asking that they be removed, and stating that German property taken for public use might be discussed.
