translations.idiomatic: After Minister Mumm left China, Chargé von Gerold protested that limits on foreign land purchases at treaty ports violated treaty and asked that they be lifted, adding that German property taken for public use could be negotiated.

sentences.zh: 六月，德人李卜克在北京設立學堂，德使請中國攤出經費，不許。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the German Lippek established a school in Beijing; the German minister asked China to contribute funds; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month a German named Lippek opened a school in Beijing; the minister asked China to share the cost, but was refused.

sentences.zh: 三十三年四月，以孫寶琦為出使德國大臣，遞國書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year Sun Baoji was appointed minister to Germany and presented a letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Guangxu 33 Sun Baoji was appointed minister to Germany and presented credentials.

sentences.zh: 是月，外務部咨改訂青島租界製成貨物徵稅新章。

translations.literal: That month the Foreign Ministry memorialized to revise the new regulations on taxation of manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Foreign Ministry sought to revise the tax regulations on manufactured goods in the Qingdao concession.

sentences.zh: 初，青島設關徵稅一事，已於與德使海靖議定辦法，嗣於三十一年又與德使穆默修改，其大意即系德國允在海邊劃一地界，作為停泊船隻、起下貨物之定所，凡出口貨在未下船以前，即完出口稅，進口貨除軍用各物暨租地內所用機器並建修物料免稅外，其餘百貨，於起岸後未出新定之界以前，即完進口稅，關員在彼辦理，德國相助無阻。

translations.literal: Initially the matter of establishing customs and levying taxes at Qingdao had been settled with Minister Heyking; later in the thirty-first year it was revised with Minister Mumm. The gist was that Germany allowed a zone on the shore as a place for vessels to anchor and cargo to be loaded and unloaded; export goods paid export duty before leaving the ship; import goods, except military articles and machinery and building materials used within the leased area, paid import duty after landing but before leaving the newly defined zone; customs officers worked there and Germany gave unhindered assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Customs at Qingdao had first been arranged with Heyking and revised with Mumm in Guangxu 31: Germany set aside a shore zone for anchorage and cargo handling; export duty was paid before goods left the ship; imports paid duty after landing but before leaving the zone, except military goods and machinery and building materials for the lease—customs operated there with German cooperation.

sentences.zh: 又由中國允每於結底，將本結所收進口稅提出二成，撥交青島德國官憲應用。

translations.literal: China also agreed that at each settlement twenty percent of import duties collected in that period would be turned over to the German authorities at Qingdao for their use.
translations.idiomatic: China also agreed to remit twenty percent of each period's import duties to the German authorities at Qingdao.

sentences.zh: 既因續訂章程，德租界內製成貨物徵稅一條，語義未盡，因與德使葛爾士再訂徵稅新章。

translations.literal: Because the article on taxing manufactured goods within the German concession in the revised regulations was not fully clear, new tax regulations were again drawn up with Minister von Gerold.
translations.idiomatic: Because the revised regulations left the taxation of manufactured goods in the concession unclear, China and von Gerold drew up new tax rules.

sentences.zh: 初，中國欲修天津至鎮江鐵路，與德、英借款，已立合同。

translations.literal: Initially China wished to build a railway from Tianjin to Zhenjiang and had already concluded a loan contract with Germany and Britain.
translations.idiomatic: China had planned a Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway financed by German and British loans and had already signed a contract.

sentences.zh: 至是，直隸、江蘇、山東三省京官請攬歸自修，命張之洞、袁世凱商辦，議改合同，德、英執不允。

translations.literal: At this point metropolitan officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong asked to take the project back for self-construction; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were ordered to negotiate; they sought to alter the contract, but Germany and Britain firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan officials from Zhili, Jiangsu, and Shandong then asked to build the line with Chinese funds; Zhang Zhidong and Yuan Shikai were ordered to negotiate a revised contract, but Germany and Britain refused.

sentences.zh: 乃又增派外務部右侍郎梁敦彥會同張之洞等籌議。

translations.literal: The court then additionally appointed Liang Dunyan, vice minister of the Foreign Ministry, to join Zhang Zhidong and others in planning.
translations.idiomatic: The court then added Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Liang Dunyan to the negotiations with Zhang Zhidong and others.

sentences.zh: 初，津鎮鐵路借款之開議也，德使增索接造支路二道，一由德州至正定，一由兗州至開封，為原議所無，不允。

translations.literal: When the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway loan was first discussed, the German minister additionally demanded two branch lines—one from Dezhou to Zhengding and one from Yanzhou to Kaifeng—not in the original plan; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of Tianjin–Pukou loan talks the German minister demanded two new branches—from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou to Kaifeng—which had not been in the original plan; China refused.

sentences.zh: 德使乃始變計：一，允由膠澳至沂州府一段，仍作為津鎮支路，歸入官路；

translations.literal: The German minister then changed course: first, he allowed the section from Jiaozhou Bay to Yizhou prefecture to remain a branch of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang line and be included in the state railway;
translations.idiomatic: Germany then shifted position: first, the Jiaozhou Bay–Yizhou section would count as a branch of the main line under state control;

sentences.zh: 二，允由濟南府往山東界之一道，包入津鎮官路。

translations.literal: second, he allowed the line from Jinan prefecture to the Shandong border to be folded into the state Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway.
translations.idiomatic: second, the Jinan–Shandong border line would also be included in the state railway.

sentences.zh: 中國亦允由德州至正定府及由兗州府或幹路中之他處過濟寧州至開封府兩支路，於十五年內由中國自行籌辦，並聲明儻用洋款，須向德華公司商借。

translations.literal: China also agreed that the two branches from Dezhou to Zhengding prefecture and from Yanzhou prefecture or another point on the trunk line via Jining prefecture to Kaifeng prefecture would be built by China on its own within fifteen years, declaring that if foreign funds were used they must be borrowed from the Sino-German company.
translations.idiomatic: China agreed to build the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches itself within fifteen years, declaring that any foreign loans must be negotiated with the Sino-German company.

sentences.zh: 至是遂由梁敦彥與德、英銀行等改訂借款合同二十四款，名為中國國家天津浦口鐵路五釐利息借款。

translations.literal: Thereupon Liang Dunyan and the German and British banks revised the loan contract into twenty-four articles, entitled the Chinese Imperial Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dunyan then signed a revised twenty-four-article loan with the German and British banks—the Imperial Chinese Tianjin–Pukou Railway Five Percent Loan.

sentences.zh: 既定議，即由外務部牒德使，聲明膠沂、濟東路線應作為津鎮支路，其由德州至正定、兗州至開封支路，均由中國自造。

translations.literal: Once agreed, the Foreign Ministry sent a note to the German minister stating that the Jiaoyi and Jidong lines should serve as branches of the Tianjin–Zhenjiang railway, while the branches from Dezhou to Zhengding and from Yanzhou to Kaifeng would all be built by China.
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Ministry then notified the German minister that the Jiaozhou–Yizhou and Jinan–border lines would be branches of the main railway, while the Dezhou–Zhengding and Yanzhou–Kaifeng branches would be built by China alone.

sentences.zh: 已，復與德議訂電政合同，即青、煙、滬水線交接辦法，並購回京沽軍線條款，及山東鐵路附設電線辦法章程共十四款。

translations.literal: Thereafter a telegraph agreement was also concluded with Germany—the Qingdao–Yantai–Shanghai cable handover, terms for repurchasing the Beijing–Taku military line, and regulations for telegraph wires along the Shandong railway—fourteen articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: China and Germany then concluded a fourteen-article telegraph agreement covering the Qingdao–Yantai–Shanghai cable handover, repurchase of the Beijing–Taku military line, and wires along the Shandong railway.

sentences.zh: 是年，德柏林賽衛生民學會及萬國玩耍排列館請中國派員入會，許之。

translations.literal: That year the Berlin Hygiene Society and the International Hygiene Exhibition invited China to send representatives to join; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year Berlin's Hygiene Society and the International Hygiene Exhibition invited China to send delegates; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東巡撫孫寶琦與德訂收回各路礦權合同。

translations.literal: In the third year Shandong governor Sun Baoji concluded with Germany a contract for recovering mining rights along the various lines.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong, Governor Sun Baoji of Shandong concluded a contract with Germany to recover railway-zone mining rights.

sentences.zh: 初，德商礦務公司照約在坊子、馬莊開礦，屢禁華人在附近開礦，爭執有年。

translations.literal: Initially the German mining company had opened mines at Fangzi and Mazhuang under treaty and repeatedly forbade Chinese to mine nearby; disputes had lasted years.
translations.idiomatic: The German mining company had long operated at Fangzi and Mazhuang under treaty while repeatedly barring Chinese mining nearby, provoking years of dispute.

sentences.zh: 迨津浦借款合同簽定，又要索膠沂、津浦路內礦權，並請封禁大汶口華礦，政府不許。

translations.literal: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan was signed they again demanded mining rights along the Jiaoyi and Tianjin–Pukou lines and asked that Chinese mines at Dawenkou be closed; the government refused.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianjin–Pukou loan was signed they again claimed mining rights along those lines and sought to shut Chinese mines at Dawenkou; the government refused.

sentences.zh: 於是德使照會始有劃清礦權之語。

translations.literal: Only then did the German minister's note speak of demarcating mining rights.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did the German minister's note propose demarcating mining rights.

sentences.zh: 孫寶琦即派道員蕭應椿等與德公司總辦畢象賢、領事貝斯商議收回，而畢象賢等則以中國欲收回三路礦權，須以相當之利益互換，否則不允。

translations.literal: Sun Baoji at once sent Circuit Intendant Xiao Yingchun and others to negotiate recovery with the company's general manager Bi Xiangxian and Consul Besse; Bi and his colleagues held that if China wished to recover mining rights on the three lines, equivalent benefits must be exchanged, or they would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Baoji sent Circuit Intendant Xiao Yingchun to negotiate with General Manager Bi Xiangxian and Consul Besse; they insisted that recovery of the three railway mining zones required equivalent compensation.

sentences.zh: 初議淄、博礦界，公司第一次繪送礦界圖，系淄川全境，並毗連博山，蕭應椿等以淄、博窮黎向以採煤為衣食，若兩境全為公司所有，勢必至華民無以為生，因議博境全留，淄境各半，以天臺、昆侖兩山為界，山北歸公司，山南歸華人，公司未允。

translations.literal: They first discussed the Zichuan and Boshan mining boundaries; the company first submitted a map covering all of Zichuan and adjoining Boshan. Xiao Yingchun and others argued that the poor of Zichuan and Boshan had long lived by coal mining; if both districts fell entirely to the company, Chinese would have no livelihood. They therefore proposed leaving all of Boshan and half of Zichuan, with Tiantai and Kunlun mountains as the boundary—north to the company, south to Chinese—but the company did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Talks began on the Zichuan–Boshan boundary when the company claimed all of Zichuan and adjoining Boshan. Xiao argued that locals depended on coal and proposed leaving all of Boshan and half of Zichuan, divided by the Tiantai and Kunlun ranges—north to the company, south to Chinese miners—but the company refused.

sentences.zh: 蕭應椿因親赴淄川會畢象賢查勘，並邀集紳董礦商，旋議定淄川東南境由大奎山起斜經龍口鎮西北至淄川東境為界，界南礦產歸華商辦理，博山亦全讓還，次議淄川華礦，次議濰縣礦界，次議金嶺鎮鐵礦，次議償給勘礦購地費。

translations.literal: Xiao Yingchun therefore went in person to Zichuan to meet Bi Xiangxian on survey and convened gentry and miners; they soon fixed the southeast of Zichuan with a boundary from Daikui Mountain slanting northwest via Longkou town to the eastern border of Zichuan, minerals south of the line to be worked by Chinese merchants; Boshan was fully returned; then they discussed Chinese mines in Zichuan, the Weixian boundary, the Jinling town iron mine, and compensation for survey and land purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao then surveyed Zichuan with Bi and local gentry, fixing a boundary from Daikui Mountain through Longkou to Zichuan's eastern border, with minerals south of the line reserved for Chinese operators; Boshan was fully restored; talks followed on Zichuan Chinese mines, the Weixian boundary, the Jinling iron mine, and compensation for survey and land costs.

sentences.zh: 自是公司已成之膠濟鐵路，未成之津浦鐵路，甫勘之膠沂路，及曹州教案條約許與公司之三十里礦權，均允取消。

translations.literal: Thereupon the company agreed to cancel mining rights along the completed Jiaoji railway, the unfinished Tianjin–Pukou railway, the newly surveyed Jiaoyi line, and the thirty-mile zones granted the company under the Caozhou missionary treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The company then agreed to relinquish mining rights along the completed Jiaoji line, the unfinished Tianjin–Pukou line, the surveyed Jiaozhou–Yizhou line, and the thirty-mile zones granted under the Caozhou treaty.
